title: Split setup_offline_docs.sh and optimize_arch_desktop.sh, deferring libre_translate.sh
objective: Bring setup_offline_docs.sh (713) and optimize_arch_desktop.sh (623) under the 250-line cap, and confirm that a script with many globals written in one half and read in the other cannot be split cleanly.
acceptance_criteria: Both entry scripts and all seven new libs are at most 250 lines.
The pre-commit shellcheck hook passes on every touched file, with no new suppression and no disable directive.
No lib sources a sibling: each entry sources every lib directly.
The stubbed run reports every moved function as defined for both scripts.
No script is executed. One downloads documentation archives, the other writes sysctl and udev settings.
libre_translate.sh is fully restored to 488 lines, leaving the unrelated lib already in that directory in place.
out_of_scope: Executing any download or tuning step.
libre_translate.sh, which has nineteen globals crossing any seam.
Changing what any script does when run.
verifier: meta/scripts/verify_shell_split.sh per script, plus pre-commit run --files, plus check_file_length.sh, plus ls of the shared lib/ directory after the revert.
